nodes.label: ADR-019 Backend window tidal harmonics and optional AI narrative
nodes.summary: Accepted 2026-10-07: pure-PHP incremental QR least-squares for eight constituents, effective amplitudes and provisional Formzahl, deterministic narrative and optional AI polish.
nodes.rationale: Gemini timeouts must not prevent calculations or initial text; installed PHP dependencies suit shared hosting.
nodes.status: Accepted; quality cutoffs are application policy, not official KKPRL standards
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Incremental Givens QR tidal least squares
nodes.summary: Constant/trend plus M2,S2,K1,O1,N2,Q1,M4,MS4 sine/cosine; UTC hours/metres, centered/scaled trend, demeaned height; incremental QR avoids normal equations and whole design matrix.
nodes.rationale: Numerically stable pure-PHP calculation must use every valid sample on shared hosting.

nodes.label: Window Formzahl estimate and ambiguity flags
nodes.summary: F=(A_K1+A_O1)/(A_M2+A_S2), unrounded bins 0.25/1.5/3; within 5% of thresholds flagged for review; only effective window amplitudes, no P1/K2 separation/nodal correction/confidence interval/prediction/datum.
nodes.rationale: Short-record fit is not a full astronomical station analysis or proof of tidal type.

nodes.label: Conservative tidal harmonic quality policy
nodes.summary: Minimum 200 samples, 28-day span, ≥90% coverage, no gap >3h, nonsingular QR and finite/nonzero denominator, tide-only R²≥0.90; failure leaves Formzahl/type null with reason.
nodes.rationale: Application policy guards provisional interpretation; 28 days reflects about 27.55-day Rayleigh separation, not official KKPRL standard.

nodes.label: Versioned deterministic tide narrative
nodes.summary: Verify file/context then store harmonic metadata version window_harmonic_ols_qr_v1; algorithm changes increment version; deterministic narrative and optional AI polish preview persist until user confirm.
nodes.rationale: Provider timeout must not lose locally computed evidence or replace newer/manual narrative.
